title: Redwood Shadows
author: Chris Page
problems: Row 2 "next neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: swing starts before a waiting couple finishes crossing.
Row 3 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "balance the ring" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 7 "mad robins ½ around, robins in front, around partners" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad robin needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
